title: Ernest Cagnolatti, Paul Barbarin and Joe Longagne
summary: He worked with trumpeters Cagnolatti and Barbarin in the 30s and Longagne, who led a brass band and played Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Ernie Cagnall Alley? Yeah.

Well, he played up there with us too. I mean back in the old days. Well, I used to get jobs before that, you know. Well, I used to get jobs and I used to hire him. I ain't the hell not. Did you like his trumpet play? Yeah.
They worked together with Paul Barberin too. Yeah, we worked together with Paul. I mean anything back in the 30s, back then. No.

Oh, more about the Joe Longagne. I know nothing about him except he led a brass band. Did he play dance bands too? Yeah. I used to play jobs when he set up. What kind of trumpet player was he? Was he a straight man or played variations? No, no. I was mostly a straight band. I see. Did he just use orchestrations or would he play some Dixieland numbers? He used to play Dixieland numbers.
